pattern: System auto-pauses the job because the property is not tenanted ('Please review and resolve this manually') during void check-out works
notes: Unmutated source history; the marker sits on event 013, so the agent sees events 001-012: the landlord asked for a comparison quote (event 009), the agency noted it and assigned a new provider (events 010-011), and the system then moved the job to Paused because the property is NOT TENANTED, asking for manual review (event 012). The recorded next action is 'Hold for TT to respond' (event 013), which waits on a tenant who has left; the rubric does not reward that. Differs from 008-second-quote (cut at 009) by what is tested: the base tests reading the landlord's reply; this tests handling a system pause that is expected for void works, without escalating it or waiting on a tenant. Expected: record that the flat is void after check-out so the pause is expected, keep the job moving (second quote requested from the new provider with the scope and the check-out report, access through agency keys), hold for the provider with a review date, confirm to the landlord. No escalation.
